answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to commit assets like copper or digital credits to validate network truth. By tying identity to capital, the system forces attackers to incur prohibitive financial costs to spawn replicas, effectively trapping malicious nodes in a performance lagoon where the expense of acquiring enough stake to dominate consensus outweighs any illicit gain. Like a quill marking a ledger, the immutable bond ensures that every actor remains accountable to their economic pledge.
